Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Jacksonville hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 15 Jacksonville hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 4, KAYAK.com at 2, Super.com at 2 and Traveluro at 1. These are the Jacksonville rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 9 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Taxes and fees at Jacksonville hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($16 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 13% at Home2 Suites by Hilton Jacksonville Downtown to 14% at Wyndham Garden Jacksonville. At 2 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
